svg.title: Where a tool comes from
svg.desc: A tool is either builtin, with its schema from SCHEMA and a function bound by the factory, or mcp_stdio, where MCPStdioServer launches the server, lists its tools and calls them. Both reach the agent loop in the same shape, so the loop cannot tell them apart.
